tasks.title: Closed grammar, Muse Spark decision engine (ModelPort), rain loop, before-you-ask transition
tasks.goal: Grammar and CommandInterpreter (model off) with the rain loop: LEAVE_LATER and CHANGE_ROUTE travel as a session-scoped UserRequestOverride into the depart preparer's extended prepareWithRequest entry (design section 2.3) - no synthetic memory facts, no fake signals, never persisted, Undo clears it, Why renders 'Because you asked ... this time only' with user_request provenance. WHY/ACCEPT/UNDO and honest UNSUPPORTED included. Rev4: Muse Spark implements the CommandInterpreter seam server-side via ModelPort (situation attribution, preference/constraint conflict resolution, candidate selection/ranking with enumerated reason codes; schema-validated and fact-checked; model never originates facts). Deterministic grammar/ranking is the fallback; the UI shows 'Meta model · live' vs 'Offline fallback · deterministic'; a redacted decision log (template id, input fact ids, output codes, validation result) is inspectable; tests use recorded fixtures and live calls stay behind the SUBMIT plan's S1 owner gate. Also: the replayable clear->rain before-you-ask scene transition (no typing, reduced-motion safe) and the Why provenance chain (timestamp, demo city, source, authorization status per signal).
checks: Gate: core zero diff; golden 10/10; grammar unit tests for LEAVE_LATER/CHANGE_ROUTE/WHY/ACCEPT/UNDO plus unknown mode mapping to UNSUPPORTED

Negative test: after 'leave 15 minutes later' (this time only), storage contains no new or changed confirmed fact, and Why shows user_request provenance distinct from confirmed facts; Undo restores the prior plan and clears the override

Honest copy and identity: working-state strings name the actual recomputation with simulated labelling (no 'real-time' claims); chat header reads 'Offline demo · simulated'; Yori avatar is the mark/logo, not a person photo; on desktop the conversation expands as a floating overlay panel, not a permanent column

Rev4 causality golden G-RAIN (add-only): same user/lesson clear->rain changes departure and ranking with the weather signal cited in Why; the recorded chain signal->reasoning (model or fallback, labelled)->suggestion->confirm->state matches under recorded model fixtures AND with the model off (deterministic fallback), with the engine status honestly displayed in both runs

Decision-log test: each model decision appends a redacted entry (template id, input fact ids, output codes, validation result) containing no secret and no raw personal content; schema-invalid or uncited model output is discarded to deterministic ranking
Interaction e2e at 390x844 and 1280x800: home->chat->send->processing->comparison->confirm->updated home->Undo; axe green; screenshots per state
Recordability: the app previews and both demo scenes remain runnable end to end in this slice's state (v1 flag path intact)

tasks.title: PlacesProvider (Overpass default) + fuel plugin + FIND_FUEL + navigate handoff
tasks.goal: PlacesProvider seam shared by lunch (real mode) and the new fuel plugin (detector+preparer+adapter, zero core diff, AC-EXT-1 path). FIND_FUEL joins the closed grammar ('gas'/'find gas'/'加油' with context disambiguation and needs-confirmation when ambiguous). Navigate handoff only on user click via unit-tested Google/Apple Maps URL builders with platform fallback. Provider-unavailable is prominent; no fabricated merchants, distances, or ETAs (straight-line labelled, or OSRM with terms noted). If the owner chose Google Places, GATE-P-BILL must be DONE first and the key lives server-side only. Build and test against a recorded/simulated PlacesProvider fixture (clearly labelled simulated); the live provider call is NOT part of this slice. Rev6 GROUNDING: provider results become EvidenceRecords in a session EvidenceBundle; every displayed POI/ETA/route/weather value carries sourceRef {recordId, field} (provenance classes via the existing classifyFactSource, no core types). GroundedRecommendationVerifier.verify runs INSIDE the render view-model path and INSIDE the navigate-URL builder (not skippable): on failure the field shows unknown or the card is withheld, navigation is disabled (no URL built), and the reason is logged redacted to the Decision Log. It EXTENDS the G12-CORE verifier (already guarding the recorded scenes) to PlacesProvider results and the navigate-URL builder.
tasks.owner_gate: P-BILL applies only if Google Places is chosen at GATE-P-LOC: owner provides key + billing; otherwise Overpass needs no key

GROUNDING G1: every rendered POI/ETA/route/weather value in tests resolves through sourceRef to a bundle record whose normalized field equals the displayed value; provenance class matches the record (simulated/recorded/live/sample/confirmed/session distinct)
